product.title: Yarra Valley Wine Day Tour

description.text: In Melbourne, this full-day wine outing uses selected city hotels and published cellar doors including De Bortoli Winery for a cheese pairing and Yering Station for tasting and lunch. The public page lists an a la carte vineyard lunch and a maximum of 11 travelers rather than a sunrise balloon. The format suits visitors who want guided Yarra Valley tastings without a Great Ocean Road coastal day. Meeting points are confirmed the evening before in Melbourne, and the itinerary stays on those wineries that define this outing rather than a Rod Laver Arena sports circuit.

highlights: De Bortoli cheese and wine pairing

start.description: You MUST contact the local tour operator by calling 96998148 up until 9:00pm the evening prior to confirm your exact pick up point and time from the published Melbourne hotel list, or meet at the confirmed Melbourne VIC 3000 meeting point.

end.description: Return to the Melbourne meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
